source_license: Reuse existing source and provenance; no new geometry, textures or skeleton changes.
requirements: Drive locomotion from actual displacement; movement intent against a wall must not advance a walking cycle.
World-space stance anchors survive forward, backward, strafe and heading changes without planted-foot sliding.
Swing planning preserves position continuity across starts, stops, mid-swing redirection and restart.
Explicit reset policy for spawn, round change, teleport and invalid/discontinuous time; pause must not accumulate motion.
Stride/cadence and contact targets must be checked on the real skin at engine slow/run speeds 2.6/5.3 m/s.
Keep rifle palm/finger constraints and actual muzzle alignment; no legacy rigid-bone animation on skin actors.
Keep body/shoe vertex streams, sole calibration and LOD source bytes exact.
Measure five simultaneously animated actors in the real scene before accepting runtime cost.
scope_limits: Flat-ground calibration first; slopes, jumping and complete aim/flinch channels remain part of the overall goal and require their own evidence.
Existing clothing fit and full-grip limitations are not waived by movement checks.
No CS2-equivalence or acceptable-FPS claim until complete gameplay evidence exists.
